AUDIENCE & TESTABILITY:
API audience: ADVANCED-LOW-LEVEL.
Harness testability: TESTABLE-WITH-LOW-LEVEL-CONSTRUCTION.
Scoring recommendation: include only in advanced/internal bucket.

ROOT CAUSE:
The documentation incorrectly suggests using `DefaultResizerFactory.getInstance()`, but `DefaultResizerFactory` is either package-private or not in the expected package, leading to a `cannot find symbol` compilation error. To use `resizerFactory`, callers must provide a valid implementation of the public `net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.ResizerFactory` interface rather than relying on internal/undocumented factory classes.

CORRECT USAGE:
```java
net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.ResizerFactory customFactory = new net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.ResizerFactory() {
    @Override
    public net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.Resizer getResizer() {
        return null; // Stub for configuration test
    }
    
    @Override
    public net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.Resizer getResizer(java.awt.Dimension originalSize, java.awt.Dimension thumbnailSize) {
        return null; // Stub for configuration test
    }
};

net.coobird.thumbnailator.Thumbnails.Builder<java.awt.image.BufferedImage> builder = 
    net.coobird.thumbnailator.Thumbnails.of(new java.awt.image.BufferedImage(100, 100, java.awt.image.BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB))
        .size(50, 50)
        .resizerFactory(customFactory);
```

REQUIRED TYPES & IMPORTS:
net.coobird.thumbnailator.Thumbnails
net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.ResizerFactory
net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.Resizer
java.awt.Dimension
java.awt.image.BufferedImage

DOC MUST SAY:
- `DefaultResizerFactory` is not part of the public API and cannot be accessed directly by external callers.
- To use `resizerFactory`, callers must implement the `net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.ResizerFactory` interface themselves (or use a publicly accessible factory if one is explicitly provided by the library).
- The `ResizerFactory` interface requires implementing `getResizer()` and `getResizer(Dimension, Dimension)`, both of which must return a `net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.Resizer`.
